    UseThisAbility _ (isSource attrs -> True) 1 -> do
      deck <- unDeck <$> getEncounterDeck
      (others, rest) <- breakM (pure . (`cardMatch` card_ #enemy)) deck
      case rest of
        -- No enemy in the deck; leave the deck as revealed (nothing to spawn).
        -- TODO: if the encounter deck is exhausted without an enemy, the discard
        -- should be shuffled in and revealing continued.
        [] -> pure ()
        (enemyCard : remaining) -> do
          -- Shuffle each other revealed card and place them on top of the deck.
          shuffledOthers <- shuffleM others
          setEncounterDeck $ Deck (shuffledOthers <> remaining)
          createEnemyWith_ enemyCard (SpawnAtLocationMatching $ FirstLocation [EmptyLocation, Anywhere]) id
      pure a
    -- Chronicle scenario-fixes: revealing does not remove cards from the deck.
    -- Scan it once, including the no-enemy case, and shuffle every other
    -- revealed card. An empty starting deck is refilled before this effect.
    UseThisAbility _ (isSource attrs -> True) 1 -> do
      deck <- unDeck <$> getEncounterDeck
      when (null deck) $ push ShuffleEncounterDiscardBackIn
      doStep 1 msg
      pure a
    DoStep 1 ability@(UseThisAbility _ (isSource attrs -> True) 1) -> do
      deck <- unDeck <$> getEncounterDeck
      let (others, rest) = break (`cardMatch` card_ #enemy) deck
      shuffledOthers <- shuffleM others
      case rest of
        [] -> setEncounterDeck $ Deck shuffledOthers
        enemyCard : remaining -> do
          let completedDeck = shuffledOthers <> remaining
          setEncounterDeck $ Deck completedDeck
          createEnemyWith_ enemyCard (SpawnAtLocationMatching $ FirstLocation [EmptyLocation, Anywhere]) id
          -- Only removing the sole card can actually empty this deck. Finish
          -- spawning before its exhaustion window and discard reshuffle.
          when (null completedDeck) $ doStep 2 ability
      pure a
    DoStep 2 (UseThisAbility _ (isSource attrs -> True) 1) -> do
      deck <- unDeck <$> getEncounterDeck
      when (null deck) do
        checkWhen Window.EncounterDeckRunsOutOfCards
        push ShuffleEncounterDiscardBackIn
      pure a

  FoundAndDrewEncounterCard iid cardSource card -> do
    -- Chronicle scenario-fixes: the saved choice owns both its original
    -- encounter deck and its source zone, even if the investigator moves.
    let
      (deckKey, fromDeck, fromDiscard, signifier) = case cardSource of
        FromEncounterDeck -> (RegularEncounterDeck, True, False, Just Deck.EncounterDeck)
        FromKeyedEncounterDeck key -> (key, True, False, Just $ Deck.EncounterDeckByKey key)
        FromDiscard -> (RegularEncounterDeck, False, True, Just Deck.EncounterDiscard)
        FromKeyedEncounterDiscard key -> (key, False, True, Just Deck.EncounterDiscard)
        _ -> (RegularEncounterDeck, False, False, Nothing)
      handler = specificEncounterDeckHandler deckKey
      removeChosen = filter ((/= toCardId card) . toCardId)
      encounterDeck = unDeck $ a ^. deckLens handler
      remainingDeck = if fromDeck then removeChosen encounterDeck else encounterDeck
      discard = a ^. discardLens handler
      remainingDiscard = if fromDiscard then removeChosen discard else discard
    shuffled <- shuffleM remainingDeck
    push $ InvestigatorDrewEncounterCardFrom iid card signifier
    pure $ a & (deckLens handler .~ Deck shuffled) & (discardLens handler .~ remainingDiscard)

getDoomTarget :: [Window] -> Target
getDoomTarget [] = error "wrong window"
getDoomTarget ((windowType -> Window.PlacedDoom _ doomTarget _) : _) = doomTarget
getDoomTarget (_ : xs) = getDoomTarget xs

module Arkham.Event.Events.FortuneOrFate2 (

  FortuneOrFate2 (..),
) where

import Arkham.Prelude

import Arkham.Classes
import Arkham.Classes.HasQueue (withQueue_)
import Arkham.Event.Cards qualified as Cards
import Arkham.Event.Runner
import Arkham.Window (Window (..))
import Arkham.Window qualified as Window

newtype FortuneOrFate2 = FortuneOrFate2 EventAttrs
  deriving anyclass (IsEvent, HasModifiersFor, HasAbilities)
  deriving newtype (Show, Eq, ToJSON, FromJSON, Entity)

fortuneOrFate2 :: EventCard FortuneOrFate2
fortuneOrFate2 = eventWith FortuneOrFate2 Cards.fortuneOrFate2 $ afterPlayL .~ ExileThis

getDoomWindow :: [Window] -> Window
getDoomWindow [] = error "wrong window"
getDoomWindow (w@(windowType -> Window.PlacedDoom {}) : _) = w
getDoomWindow (_ : xs) = getDoomWindow xs

-- Chronicle scenario-fixes: cancel pending doom and honor printed exile.
-- Only the pending placement that opened this window is reduced. Existing doom
-- is untouched, and later placements (including the same target) stay queued.
-- Agenda doom already has its After window in the batch; other runners produce
-- their After windows from the reduced Do message when the mutation resolves.
preventOneDoom :: Window -> [Message] -> [Message]
preventOneDoom window = snd . go
 where
  (source, target) = case windowType window of
    Window.PlacedDoom s t _ -> (s, t)
    _ -> error "wrong doom window"
  matches s t = source == s && target == t
  matchesBatch batch = maybe True (== batch) (windowBatchId window)

  go [] = (False, [])
  go (Would batch messages : rest)
    | matchesBatch batch = case go messages of
        (True, messages') -> (True, Would batch messages' : rest)
        (False, _) -> let (found, rest') = go rest in (found, Would batch messages : rest')
  go (Do (PlaceDoom s t n) : rest)
    | matches s t =
        let remaining = max 0 (n - 1)
         in (True, [Do (PlaceDoom s t remaining) | remaining > 0] <> remainingAfter remaining rest)
  go (DoBatch batch (PlaceDoom s t n) : rest)
    | matchesBatch batch && matches s t =
        let remaining = max 0 (n - 1)
         in (True, [DoBatch batch (PlaceDoom s t remaining) | remaining > 0] <> remainingAfter remaining rest)
  go (message : rest) = let (found, rest') = go rest in (found, message : rest')

  -- A prebuilt After immediately follows the agenda mutation. Do not traverse
  -- later batches or independent placements while updating this receipt.
  remainingAfter n (CheckWindows ws : rest)
    | any matchingReceipt ws =
        [CheckWindows ws' | notNull ws'] <> rest
   where
    ws' = mapMaybe (receipt n) ws
  remainingAfter n (Do (CheckWindows ws) : rest)
    | any matchingReceipt ws =
        [Do (CheckWindows ws') | notNull ws'] <> rest
   where
    ws' = mapMaybe (receipt n) ws
  remainingAfter _ rest = rest

  matchingReceipt w = case windowType w of
    Window.PlacedDoom s t _ -> matches s t
    _ -> False
  receipt n w
    | matchingReceipt w =
        if n > 0 then Just w {windowType = Window.PlacedDoom source target n} else Nothing
    | otherwise = Just w

instance RunMessage FortuneOrFate2 where
  runMessage msg e@(FortuneOrFate2 attrs) = case msg of
    InvestigatorPlayEvent _ eid _ (getDoomWindow -> window) _ | eid == toId attrs -> do
      withQueue_ $ preventOneDoom window
      pure e
    _ -> FortuneOrFate2 <$> runMessage msg attrs
